title: Vectors: checkin_rollcall.json cbor_length fields are stale
description: 18 of 25 payload vectors in test/vectors/checkin_rollcall.json have cbor_length values that disagree with the actual byte length of their own cbor_hex (e.g. rollcall_status_response claims 220, hex is 250; checkin_minimal claims 64, hex is 65; checkin_boundary_coords claims 83, hex is 91). The cbor_hex bytes are canonical (cbor2 round-trip verified for all 25). Any consumer asserting len(wire)==cbor_length fails; the C suite (gen_vectors.py) deliberately derives lengths from cbor_hex and ignores cbor_length. Fix: recompute all cbor_length values from the hex. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.10.19.3; related sibling defect in project-LICHEN-worker6-2yps (different file).
close_reason: Recomputed cbor_length for all 18 stale vectors in test/vectors/checkin_rollcall.json from the authoritative cbor_hex; generator comment updated. Verified: zero stale fields remain; host C suite lichen/tests/checkin_rollcall green (ctest 1/1, ASan/UBSan build); Rust checkin_rollcall_vectors 13/13; no Python consumer exists for this JSON (rg across python/tests/ empty) and the two cbor_length-asserting Python consumers target receipt/sos files only. Commit <see git log>.
